title: MS-TTRL: Breaking the Frequency Conflict in Multiple-Solution Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific, engineering, and mathematical reasoning tasks can admit multiple valid solutions, while exhaustive annotation of the full solution set is often prohibitively costly. Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) applies reinforcement learning to unlabeled test instances, offering a label-free approach to multiple-solution reasoning. In this setting, generation frequency serves two opposing objectives: correctness estimation favors frequent outcomes, whereas outcome-level diversity preservation favors less frequent outcomes. We term this tension the \textbf{Frequency Conflict}. To resolve this conflict, we propose MS-TTRL, which obtains frequency-independent correctness estimates through Outcome-Level Self-Verification while reserving generation frequency solely for diversity preservation. translated_title: MS-TTRL：打破多解测试时强化学习中的频率冲突
translated_abstract: 科学、工程和数学推理任务往往存在多个有效解，而对完整解集进行穷尽式标注的代价通常高昂得令人望而却步。测试时强化学习将强化学习应用于无标签的测试实例，为多解推理提供了一种无需标签的方法。在这一设定中，生成频率服务于两个相互对立的目标：正确性估计偏好高频出现的结果，而结果层面的多样性保持则偏好低频出现的结果。我们将这种张力称为“频率冲突”。为解决这一冲突，我们提出MS-TTRL，它通过结果级自验证获得与频率无关的正确性估计，同时仅将生成频率保留用于多样性保持。三态结果缓存和候选状态支持在重复观测中复用验证结果，并以置信度感知的方式处理模糊情况……
tldr: 提出MS-TTRL方法，通过结果级自验证获得与频率无关的正确性估计，并借助三态结果缓存实现验证复用，从而解决了多解测试时强化学习中生成频率在正确性估计与多样性保持之间的“频率冲突”。
en_tdlr: MS-TTRL resolves the "Frequency Conflict" in multiple-solution test-time reinforcement learning by decoupling correctness estimation from generation frequency via frequency-independent Outcome-Level Self-Verification, with a Three-State Outcome Cache enabling verification reuse across repeated observations.
